sentences.text:
Petitioner is owner of a truck bearing registration no. NL-01-AB-6262 which was seized by the District Mining Officer, Pakur loaded with 1000 CFT of stone chips.
It was submitted that the seized vehicle is a commercial vehicle and was fully under the control of the driver.
It was further submitted that the driver without the knowledge and consent of the petitioner was transporting the seized stone chips.
It was further submitted that the petitioner has got no criminal antecedent and this fact has been mentioned at paragraph 06 of the anticipatory bail application.
It was finally submitted that the petitioner has complied with the notice issued under section 41 (A) of the Cr.P.C. by appearing before the investigating officer.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case; I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on his surrender shall Rustam Sk @ Rustam Shekh vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
